experiments.question: Can a configured hard gate be distinguished from an endogenous nonlinear ignition mechanism?

design.diagnostic: transition location as configured threshold changes

results.interpretation: A gate-generated discontinuity tracks the configured threshold nearly one-for-one; an independently observed endogenous transition can remain threshold-invariant.

experiments.boundary: Diagnostic toy only. It does not show that current FRANK has endogenous ignition or hysteresis.
experiments.next_falsifier: Replay current FRANK candidate traces with configurable shadow thresholds while logging pre-gate dynamics; lesion feedback/re-entry and test whether transition sharpness/hysteresis survives.

experiments.question: Can transport succeed while receiver-specific reconstruction fails causally?

design.lesion: one target audience receives identical canonical payload but its receiver-specific reconstruction transform is removed

experiments.boundary: Constructed latent-coordinate proxy. It validates the lesion/receipt test design, not current FRANK receiver semantics.
experiments.next_falsifier: On current FRANK, hold workspace row transport constant while perturbing semantic projection/receiver uptake; measure Core/Qwen representation and downstream effect selectively.
